goal: Managed cloud inference requires extending static GPU cloud profiles with an active provisioning reconciler that drives desired/observed state transitions, generates stable operation IDs for crash recovery deduplication, runs health checks, and supports safe rollback. Acceptance requires a test that exercises the production path, not the module in isolation: this task was filed with the vector's mastery test as its acceptance, and that test passes today because the module already satisfies its own semantics - which is why the task could be closed without the integration it asks for. The named test does not exist yet, and is the work.
title: Implement desired/observed state reconciliation, operation IDs, and rollback for cloud deployments
